svg.text: Five hundred million products can't all be crawled often, so decide what is worth checking.

product and how often its price changes.

fraction of products, so prioritize those.
A scheduler decides what to crawl: products
with many subscribers or volatile prices are
checked more often; the long tail rarely.

actually see, which adds coverage for free.
